main.description: The job board: open postings that passed validation, by active authors. Served by the AppView. Amounts in different currencies are never compared: minSalary and sort=salary need a currency, and only postings in that currency match.

q.description: Words that must appear in the title, organization, description or skills (English stemming).

minSalary.description: Salary floor, in whole units of currency per salaryPeriod. A posting matches when the bottom of its range, converted to a year, is at least the floor converted to a year.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Required with minSalary or sort=salary; alone, it filters to postings in that currency.

salaryPeriod.description: The period minSalary is stated in.

location.description: Case-insensitive substring of the posting's location.

skills.description: Every one must be on the posting's skills list (case-insensitive).

sort.description: newest: most recent first. salary: highest yearly minimum first, then highest yearly maximum (needs currency).
